hints.title: Connected Region Identification
hints.text: Each round, use graph traversal to identify all separate connected components of unquarantined infected cells.

hints.title: Threat Metric Calculation
hints.text: For each region, compute its threatened boundary (set of adjacent uninfected cells) and count the number of walls required to enclose it.

hints.title: Quarantine and Spread Simulation
hints.text: Pick the region threatening the greatest number of uninfected cells and convert its cells to quarantined. For all other infected regions, spread virus to their adjacent uninfected cells. Repeat until no virus can spread.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Iterative round simulation identifying virus components, selecting maximum threat, and spreading remainder.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Wall placement without measuring uninfected neighborhood sizes allows explosive exponential infection.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Simulating state in grid coordinates requires O(M * N) memory per round.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Distinguish between number of threatened cells (unique coordinates) and wall perimeter (shared edges count multiple times).
